summary: The complete legal position domain ends at 10^14, so k has at most 47 binary digits; this bounded amount of work is too small for an honest runtime scaling verdict.

workload_bound.source_constraint: The public contract restricts k to the inclusive range from 1 through 10^14.

replacement_checks.evidence: Each binary digit of k - 1 selects one first or second half. The accepted source examines each of at most 47 digits once and accumulates exactly the selected transformations.
Authored cases cover k = 1, both operation types, multiple selected bits, a 26-step alphabet wrap, the highest legal bit level, and k = 10^14.
